name: Plate
summary: Painted enamels of this kind were commonly known in English as 'Canton enamel', after the main centre of their production in South China. They were popular export products in the 18<sub>th</sub> and 19<sub>th</sub> centuries. These copper wares were also produced in Beijing for imperial consumption.
